strips.title: A Tuesday with the Roborock Saros 10R

panels.head: 8:00 AM — you leave
panels.text: The schedule starts it after the door closes. You never think about it.

panels.head: It sees the phone cable
panels.text: Camera + AI steer around cables, socks and the dog's accident. No rescue call at work.

panels.head: Under the sofa: 3.14 inches
panels.text: No turret on top, so it cleans where every 4-inch robot gives up.

panels.head: Home: it empties itself
panels.text: The dock does the dirty work. You touch a dust bag every 7 weeks.
